guide.summary: Public integration for customers' Gusto accounts (app review).
guide.verdict: Public integration for customers' Gusto accounts (app review).

composio.note: Composio has no managed OAuth app for Gusto, so create the auth config with your own client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio has no managed OAuth app for Gusto, so you must register your own application in the Gusto developer portal and supply its client ID and secret.
reasons: Composio has no managed Gusto app
Gusto assigns scopes per app during review
Your own app gets its own quota and branding on the consent screen

scenarios.label: Public integration for customers' Gusto accounts
scenarios.when_this_applies: An AI agent product acts on behalf of outside customers' Gusto companies through OAuth.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

waiting.basis: No review timeline found in Gusto docs (c9).

scenarios.approval: Gusto reviews every application and assigns scopes from the use case. Scopes must be tested in the demo environment before production keys are issued on approval.
extras: Primary or full-access admin must enable and authorize

modifiers.note: Primary or full-access admin must enable and authorize the app.

prerequisites.title: Gusto developer account
prerequisites.detail: You need an application in the Gusto developer dashboard to get a client ID and secret.

prerequisites.title: Minimal scope list
prerequisites.detail: Gusto recommends requesting only the bare minimum scopes. Scopes are named resource plus action, such as employees:read.

steps.title: Create application in Gusto developer portal
steps.detail: Log in at dev.gusto.com and create the application to get sandbox credentials.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and secret for the demo environment.

steps.title: Draft use case and minimal scopes
steps.detail: Write the integration use-case description and a bare-minimum scope list with a reason for each.
steps.done_when: A use case and scope list are ready for review.

steps.title: Request integration review
steps.detail: Submit the integration to Gusto. The exact submission process was not found in the dossier.
steps.done_when: Gusto confirms the review has started.

steps.title: Test assigned scopes in demo
steps.detail: Exercise every scope Gusto assigns in the demo environment before approval.
steps.done_when: All assigned scopes work in the demo environment.

steps.title: Wait for Gusto approval
steps.detail: Gusto's Developer Relations team issues production keys once the integration is approved.
steps.done_when: Production keys appear in your developer account.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Gusto auth config through Composio's API with your own client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard into the Gusto app.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and the redirect URI is registered with Gusto.

steps.title: Have customer admins authorize
steps.detail: Each customer's primary or full-access admin must enable and authorize the app for their company.
steps.done_when: Each customer's connected account is active.

traps.title: Production rejects calls outside assigned scopes
traps.detail: Scopes are enforced in production on approval, so test every call you need in the demo first. Extra scopes can be requested by email only after release to production.

traps.title: Only admins can authorize
traps.detail: Only a customer's primary or full-access admin can enable the app, so ordinary users cannot connect it.

blockers.symptom: Only sandbox keys, no production keys
blockers.what_it_means: The integration has not been approved yet.
blockers.what_to_do: Finish testing the assigned scopes in the demo environment and follow up with Gusto Developer Relations.
blockers.agent_can_help: Prepare a test script covering each assigned scope.

blockers.what_it_means: The call is outside the scopes assigned to your app.
blockers.what_to_do: Check granted scopes in the Developer Portal and email Gusto to request changes.
blockers.agent_can_help: Compare failing calls against the granted scope list.

open_questions: How long does Gusto's review take? Ask Gusto Developer Relations or check the developer portal.
How do you apply for review, and what exactly is checked? Ask Gusto Developer Relations.
Does Gusto verify redirect-URI domains? Check the application settings in the Gusto developer dashboard.
